name: megascenes-graduation-card
description: Design graduation cards for the graduate in your life, with their name, your congratulations and your signature in the design.

interface.longDescription:
Give who the card is for, the main line, a short message and how you sign it, and pick the look: black and gold, confetti and caps, elegant navy, bright and fun. You get a graduation card with your words set in the design, portrait, square or wide, ready to print, post or send.

ChatGPT tells you what the card needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The card opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the words you want printed on the card: no addresses or contact details are needed.

For parents, grandparents, friends and teachers congratulating a graduate.

Limitations: designs as image files; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. It does not mail the cards. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Set the name, your congratulations and signature in the design
Return the card in the chat
defaultPrompt: A black and gold graduation card for Sofia that says Congratulations Graduate, signed Love, Mom and Dad
A bright and fun graduation card for Leo: You did it! Class of 2027
An elegant navy graduation card with the words The best is yet to come

positive.prompt: A black and gold graduation card for Sofia that says Congratulations Graduate, signed Love, Mom and Dad. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one graduation card needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A bright and fun graduation card for Leo that says You did it! Class of 2027. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one card needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design a graduation card here?
positive.expected_behavior: The graduation card models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A confetti and caps graduation card for Elena, square, with the words So proud of you, signed Grandma Anna. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my graduation card on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my graduation card to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
